about_the_game:
This album features original tracks that capture the spirit of At the Summit of Mount Rojerya. These compositions not only accompany key scenes from the game but also reflect the cold of the mountain, the solitude of the climb, and the quiet hope that lingers in the storm.

While some of the tracks are heard in-game, others are newly composed to expand the game’s thematic world. Each piece adds emotional depth, evoking the sound of howling winds, echoing footsteps on ice, and the silent cry of survival.

Whether you're revisiting the emotional landscape of the game or simply enjoying the music on its own, this soundtrack offers a powerful and immersive experience.
